title: 03 — Zdobyte uznanie
description: 3–4 s, 24f. Prawa dłoń anonimowego twórcy z grafitowym rękawem trzyma okrągły medal Złotego Emoji. To fabularny symbol zdobytego wyróżnienia, pokazany PRZED zakupem gwiazdy; nie przypisuje osiągnięcia realnej osobie. Wzór medalu jak przy portfolio w KKN. Napis: «Zdobyte uznanie.»

Input1 is same creator's home music desk, lighting and charcoal knitted cuff; match walnut tabletop and warm left key/cool right bounce, no other person. Input2 locks the exact small gold emoji medallion already shown later in the film, about6cm across, NOT the large architectural star. Input3 is authoritative medallion FACE design: round gold disk, raised rim, two FOUR-POINT STAR eyes and one wide smiling recessed mouth. Tight oblique close-up of the unnamed creator's open LEFT palm, facing upward and gently cupped, extending from bottom-left charcoal cuff. The single gold medallion rests with real weight in center of palm, upright smiling face oriented to camera, fingertips relaxed beside its rim, five natural digits including thumb. Palm and medal fill middle half of image, no oversized hand. Background is shallow-focus same walnut music desk; just an indistinct edge of controller in back, no screen, no other award. Camera looks down45degrees, light glints from medal surface physically, no magic. This is an illustrative earned distinction BEFORE visiting pawnshop, not purchase of fame. No star-shaped plaque in scene, no money, no coins pile, no writing or logos, no captions, no person face, no other hands. Leave lower15% quiet sleeve/table for separately typeset caption. Tactile real skin, mild age texture consistent with input1, not plastic.
prompts.animation: 0.0–0.8s: the creator's right fingertips curl a few millimetres around the outside edge of the gold emoji medallion, gently securing it without covering its face. 0.8–3.0s: hold. Camera: locked close-up. Secondary motion: realistic skin compression where the medal rests, with a slight natural hand tremor only. Continuity: preserve exactly one right hand with five fingers, charcoal cuff, the round medallion's size, smiling mouth and two four-point star eyes. The desk and controller stay fixed. Use the first second in the edit. Avoid closing a fist, lifting or rotating the medal, extra fingers, new jewellery, morphing, cuts, lettering or watermarks.
